label: step10-report
tail:
The step-10 report is written to `research/frontier-15-step10-report.md` (1,142 lines), and I authored no defect-ledger rows.

## What the run delivered

**8 A/B pairs, 16 pages, 398 items, all `status: draft`.** `library/measure-theory/` is a new library category.

**86 confirmed fatal defects were found and all 86 were repaired.** 81 of the 86 were caught at step 6, where a repair costs an edit; 5 reached step 8 and cost an adjudication, a repair and a rejudge. The worst were `thm-sylow-first-theorem` (a landmark whose two load-bearing inferences were *announced* rather than performed — the contract's shotgun citation bracket is why every gate passed over it), `cor-cokleisli-and-coeilenberg-moore-…` (both universal properties dualised backwards, justified by a false claim about opposite categories), and `thm-extension-generated-by-separable-elements-is-separable` (circular — the only defect both judge lanes found). I read all five step-8 repairs, the Sylow I rewrite and the monads page summary on disk myself; all are what their reports say.

## The gate state

Every terminal gate is green — including `level-coverage --verify-current-context` (398 items, 398/398 current judge pairs, exit 0), which `frontier-14` never ran clean — **except one**: `defect-ledger check --no-open` fails on a single deliberately-open nonfatal row, batch 2's ~450 generated proof-contract boundary worksheets. That is the one thing in the run asking you for a decision, and §"Publish readiness" lays out the three options.

## Three things you should know that the artifacts don't say on their own

- **One of three group Alphas didn't write its ledger rows.** Group a owned batches 1–3 (207 items, 58 of the 75 reader-found fatal defects) and wrote 13 rows, none for those findings. Batch 1 has zero rows of its own. So the ledger's "28 fatal" understates the run's real 86 by a factor of three, and the `check` gate structurally can't see it. Every ledger number in the report carries that caveat.
- **Independent refuter coverage is missing on 141 of 398 items.** The Sol lane hit its Codex quota mid-run (locked to 2026-08-20); groups a and b correctly refused to substitute silently. Batch 7 has full coverage, batch 3 nearly so, batch 2 partial, batches 1 and 4–6 none — including the Sylow I proof group a itself wrote.
- **`judge-compare.mjs` cannot read this run** — its lineup map was never updated past `deepseek+terra`, so it dies on the first Sonnet row. I computed the agreement table from the ledger directly rather than patching a tool at the reporting stage.

Two corrections I made to my own draft after checking: the A/B item split (309/89, not 328/70) and a claim that no prosecheck warning lands on a run item — exactly one does, and it's a false positive on the phrase "two of them" in `def-p-core-of-a-finite-group`.
